key_highlights: ASX set to advance on tech-led rally following Wall Street surge; oil snaps losing run (38, 31)
RBA rate hikes continue to squeeze household spending, pressuring consumer and REIT sectors (33)
Flash PMI sags, signalling softening domestic activity ahead of RBA's next decision (21)
Saudi oil shock and global diesel shortage (Iran/Ukraine) send Australian fuel prices surging; diesel crunch to persist into 2027 (41, 55, 45)
Gold miners active: Platina secures Rio funding for WA push, Broken Hill lifts SA resource, Advance hits 4120g/t silver in Mexico (40, 72, 73, 43)
China rebalancing towards robotics amid Xi political pressure; iron ore demand outlook uncertain (50, 69)
Jetstar industrial action escalates with staff waiving baggage/seat fees; Qantas confirms Sydney-New York non-stop (35, 37, 5)
Energy prices dump on US Democrat sweep expectations, offsetting some diesel shock (53)
Federal/state governments face debt cliff; Hastie open to baby bonus return (49, 70)

sectors.trend: Gold miners in active exploration phase (Platina, Broken Hill, Dalaroo, Advance). China's pivot to robotics and political instability under Xi create uncertainty for iron ore and coal demand. Diesel shortage supports energy transition narratives.
sectors.implications: Gold miners (PLA.AX, BHP.AX gold segment, DLR.AX) benefit from safe-haven flows amid geopolitical risk. BHP.AX and RIO.AX face headwinds from China demand softening. Silver discovery (Advance) supports junior miners.

sectors.trend: RBA rate hikes squeezing household spending; debt cliff for governments raises sovereign credit concerns. Energy cost mismanagement by Labor adds political risk to policy credibility.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin pressure from rate cycle peak but benefit from higher yields. Rising household stress could elevate NPLs. Government debt trajectory pressures bond markets.

sectors.trend: Saudi oil shock and global diesel shortage (Iran/Ukraine) driving fuel prices higher. US Democrat sweep expectations cause energy price volatility. Data centre energy demand threatens net-zero targets.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX benefit from elevated oil/diesel prices. Downstream refiners face margin squeeze. Renewable/energy transition names gain structural tailwind from data centre demand.

sectors.trend: Tech stocks lead ASX higher post Wall Street surge; valuations at cheapest since ChatGPT launch. Data centre build-out accelerating. China robotics pivot creates supply-chain opportunities.
sectors.implications: ASX tech names (WES.AX, XRO.AX, SPL.AX) benefit from global tech rally. Data centre demand supports infrastructure REITs. China robotics shift may benefit ASX-listed automation plays.

sectors.trend: RBA tightening and energy costs compress household budgets. Jetstar industrial action disrupts low-cost carrier economics. Qantas expands long-haul. Record sheep prices shift ag land use.
sectors.implications: QAN.AX benefits from Sydney-NY route but faces Jetstar (JLH.AX) industrial risk. MYG.AX (Myer) gets governance boost with Solly Lew board appointment. Consumer staples (WOW.AX, WES.AX) see defensive rotation.

sectors.trend: Syngenis precision medicine venture adds firepower; Centene (CNC) up 98.8% in Q2 globally. Pain trade roars domestically.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX, SYG.AX benefit from precision medicine and healthcare spending trends. Global pharma strength supports ASX healthcare sentiment.

Global diesel/oil supply shock (Saudi, Iran, Ukraine) with 2027 persistence
Gold and silver exploration activity across WA, SA, Mexico
China demand rebalancing and political risk under Xi
Tech sector valuation reset and data centre energy demand
Australian fiscal sustainability and government debt trajectory
Jetstar industrial action and aviation sector disruption
El Nino risk to agricultural output

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Global diesel shortage and oil price volatility
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge fuel exposure; favour upstream energy (WDS.AX, WLE.AX) over downstream; monitor OPEC+ and Iran/Ukraine developments

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA tightening and household spending contraction
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce consumer discretionary exposure; favour defensive staples (WOW.AX, WES.AX); monitor NPL trends at major banks

risk_assessment.risk_factor: China demand slowdown and political instability
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify away from pure iron ore/coal exposure; favour gold miners and diversified majors (BHP.AX, RIO.AX)

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Australian government debt cliff and fiscal credibility
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor bond yields; favour cash-rich, dividend-paying large caps; avoid rate-sensitive REITs

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Jetstar industrial action and aviation disruption
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid JLH.AX short-term; QAN.AX benefits from competitor disruption but watch cost inflation

risk_assessment.risk_factor: El Nino impact on agricultural output
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor ag-sector names; record sheep prices may offset crop losses

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and silver miners amid geopolitical risk and China uncertainty
opportunities.rationale: Active exploration (Platina WA, Broken Hill SA, Advance Mexico) plus safe-haven demand from oil shock and China risk

opportunities.recommendation: Add upstream energy exposure to hedge diesel/oil supply shock
opportunities.rationale: Diesel shortage to persist into 2027; Saudi oil shock supports sustained elevated prices

opportunities.recommendation: Selective tech allocation on valuation reset
opportunities.rationale: Tech at cheapest since ChatGPT launch; data centre demand structural; Wall Street surge supports ASX tech

opportunities.recommendation: Favour Qantas over Jetstar on industrial action divergence
opportunities.rationale: Jetstar staff waiving fees in protest; QAN benefits from Sydney-NY expansion and competitor disruption

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce consumer discretionary and rate-sensitive REIT exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA hikes squeezing spending; government debt cliff pressures bond yields and property valuations
China rebalancing to robotics and Xi political risk threaten commodity demand

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash buffer and quality dividend large caps
defensive_moves.rationale: Fiscal uncertainty and energy volatility favour capital preservation; CSL, CBA offer defensive yield

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to grind higher on tech momentum and oil stabilisation, but RBA tightening and PMI softness cap upside. Energy volatility from diesel shock creates sector rotation. Jetstar industrial action adds near-term noise. Expect ^AXJO to trade in a narrow range with sector dispersion.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautious. Household spending compression from rate cycle, government debt trajectory, and China demand uncertainty weigh on growth. Gold, energy, and healthcare offer relative strength. Tech re-rating possible if global valuations hold. El Nino adds ag-sector volatility. Fiscal consolidation risk is the key swing factor.
